meta.title: CATTI mock exam
meta.description: Japanese–Chinese translation level 2 mock exams: five separate banks (vocabulary, grammar, reading, ja→zh, zh→ja), free or CATTI-template paper assembly, a server-timed exam with unlimited pauses and crash recovery, objective grading with disputed answers excluded, and a report with per-question verdicts. Open it from the CATTI 模考 icon in the sidebar; data lives in workspace JSON.
